Location: The Cottage 58 West End Launton Bicester OX26 5DG. Proposal: Removal of existing outbuilding and log store, erection of annexe ancillary living space. Decision: Permitted. Decision Issued Date: 16/04/2025. Official documents include Proposed Block Plan (DWG No. 08 - 00), Proposed Outbuilding Sections (DWG No. 06 - 02), Proposed Annexe Floor Plan (DWG No. 05 - 03), and Proposed Outbuilding Elevations (DWG No. 07 - 00). The official proposal identifies one distinct new annexe/outbuilding after removal of the existing outbuilding and log store. The dedicated proposed floor, section and elevation drawings independently support that single new structure; the same register page also lists Building Control application 25/00589/FP for the same removal-and-erection proposal. Existing structures to be removed are not counted as new planned structures. Geometry/materialization is deferred to local OpenCode.
